niko.k: Morning team — tiny crisis, need to stay home today for a family emergency. Quick q: does Redwood have paid short-notice emergency care days? how do I log this so payroll covers it?
people-ops: Hey @niko.k sorry to hear that 97a We do have "Emergency Family Care" (EFC) days. Short summary: up to 5 EFC days per rolling 12 months at full base pay. Part-day coverage is pro-rated hourly. Manager approval required (can be retro within 7 days).
people-ops: Steps to request:
```
1) Tell your manager in the thread / DM
2) Fill the EFC request form: https://redwood.intra/hr/forms/efc
3) Manager approves in the form (or reply to this thread)
4) Payroll processes payment on next cycle after approval
```
niko.k: If I have to leave midday, can I claim 4 hours as EFC and the rest as PTO?
people-ops: Yes — choose partial-day on the form and indicate PTO top-up if you want to use PTO for the remaining hours. Payroll will combine entries.
poayroll: payroll: Quick note from payroll 4b3: For partial days, submit the EFC form within 5 business days. We'll pay pro-rated hours at your base hourly equivalent. Include manager approval or a reply here.
kari.mgr: @niko.k cover-wise: I can take your customer standup and swap you on the on-call for today. @ops-backup can you pick up the 3pm page?
ops-backup: got it, i'll cover 3pm-6pm. thanks for the heads up.
niko.k: Thanks all. One more: same-day backup childcare service costs me $120 tonight. Is that reimbursable or do we only reimburse daycare after return?
people-ops: We reimburse same-day backup childcare for emergency bookings. Policy: up to $200 per incident, up to $600 per rolling year, receipts required within 30 days. For larger recurring contracts we ask for pre-approval.
people-ops: To claim, follow these steps:
```
1) Submit EFC form and tick 'backup childcare claim'
2) You'll get a claim id in 48h
3) Email receipts + claim id to payroll@redwood.com
4) Payroll will reimburse on the next payment run
```
people-ops-bot: FYI reminder: Benefits continuity and childcare rebate info: https://redwood.intra/hr/benefits and https://redwood.intra/hr/forms/childcare-rebate
people-ops: If anyone needs fast help submitting from mobile, DM us and we'll walk through it. Glad we can cover you today. :heart:
niko.k: Thank you everyone, filing the form now. :pray:
